name: Javier Milei
role: President of Argentina (2023-present); economist; national deputy (2021-2023)
summary: Milei is a libertarian economist who calls himself an anarcho-capitalist in theory while governing as a minarchist: he wants a drastically smaller state limited to defending life, liberty and property, deregulation, privatisation, zero deficit, free trade and fiscal austerity. Culturally he is socially conservative on abortion, euthanasia and gender, fights what he calls the woke agenda, and rejects supranational bodies such as the UN agenda, while aligning Argentina with the United States and Israel.

notes: Living person: only stated positions and the record (decrees, Ley Bases, vetoes, speeches) were used; nothing was inferred from his party or label. He calls himself an anarcho-capitalist but governs as a minarchist, so the state and private-courts answers use his clearest recent statement (state limited to defending life, liberty and property). Full speech texts came from Le Grand Continent (Davos 2024 and 2025, with interleaved editorial commentary that was not used as evidence); UN and Davos 2026 passages are press quotations because official transcripts were not reachable. Several earlier-career statements (guns, drugs, sex work, organ sales, central bank, same-sex marriage) come via Wikipedia and press, not primary text, and are medium or low. No on-camera political quiz was found. His 2025 Davos speech is more culturally conservative than his earlier libertarian line (same-sex marriage, migration), where the most recent position was used. Pass of 2026-11-19 (rules 7): sources tagged action or words; Wikipedia-only answers were re-sourced from the record (Ley Bases, DNU 70/2023, labour reform, US trade deal, decrees, UN votes; sources s13 onward) or nulled in reviewHistory; answers resting on a general value (taxes, property, positive rights) were nulled. Themes searched this pass: economy and labour, trade, energy and nuclear, immigration, guns, justice and age of criminal responsibility, foreign policy (Israel, Cuba vote, WHO), gender ministries, education vouchers, courts and decrees, exchange rate, land law, UN General Debate speeches 2024-2025 and Davos 2024-2026 from local corpora. Searches in these themes turned up no stated position on pensions, drug policy in office, AI and encryption, animal welfare or electoral rules; those stay null. Wikipedia pages (s9-s11) are kept only as the earlier pass's finding aids and are not cited by any current answer.
